items.title: Opt-in retrieval-only mode, per-agent activation, scoped indexing (OpenCode)
items.basis: New feature, not in PRD. No ADR covers per-agent opt-in or scoped indexing. Owner decisions (no fallback chains, no npm) do not settle this; it needs an explicit v2 scope call.

items.title: stats: skip unchanged session DBs in lifetime scan (fixes #1248)
items.basis: v2 keeps one context.db (ADR-0002). The lifetime scan over many session DBs this PR speeds up does not exist in v2, so the fix is moot.

archaeology.ORIGINAL_INTENT: scan all session DBs for lifetime stats
archaeology.REGRESSION_RISK: none; v2 has no per-session DB set to scan

items.title: hooks: route quoted curl/wget stdout destinations
items.basis: ADR-0008 r3 keeps hard deny for curl/wget, fixed with a parser (not regex). This quoted-arg case must stay as a GP3 contract test row so the deny still fires on quoted stdout targets.

items.title: heal: anchor version filter (#1191)
items.basis: The start.mjs heal flow does not exist in v2 (ADR-0002: no heal step). The filter this PR adds to that flow has nothing left to attach to.

archaeology.REGRESSION_RISK: none; heal step removed for all agents
archaeology.SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: no heal step anywhere in v2

items.title: install: --legacy-peer-deps (#1174)
items.basis: Owner decision: no npm install step in v2. A flag for an install step that does not run cannot apply.

items.title: fix(codex): isolate project context for concurrent chats
items.basis: Title only; PRs are disabled so the body cannot be read, and this cannot be confirmed as fixed by design. Topic is project identity per Codex chat; add a GP7 contract test row for concurrent Codex chats once the real behaviour is confirmed.

items.title: server: wait for MCP handshake before platform storage (#1255, #1276)
items.basis: v2 reads the project source only after MCP initialize (ADR-0002/GP1, closes #1255). Add a GP1 row asserting storage writes do not start before the handshake completes.

items.title: plan-mode read-only path
items.basis: Not referenced in PRD or README. Owner's "no fallback chains" rule bears on this but does not by itself set the read-only path; needs an explicit ADR line.

items.title: echo default
items.basis: Mentioned in PRD but left undecided. No owner decision in this round sets the default; needs explicit choice before a GP row can cite it.

items.title: tool-description token budget
items.basis: Mentioned in PRD, no number fixed. Owner's reduction-mechanism rule (no truncation as the reduction mechanism) rules out one possible answer but still leaves the budget itself undecided.

items.title: Windows PowerShell hooks
items.basis: Mentioned in PRD, undecided. A related PowerShell routing case is covered elsewhere (GP3), but this hook-registration question is still open.

items.title: trigram growth bound
items.basis: Mentioned in PRD, undecided. ADR-0016 (large output never enters subagent context) governs output handling, not the index's own growth bound, so it does not close this.

items.title: Codex external-file settings
items.basis: Mentioned in PRD, undecided. No ADR fixes how v2 reads Codex settings kept in an external file.

items.title: mid-session corruption self-heal
items.basis: ADR-0002 removes the heal step entirely (also closes #1191/P1298). A self-heal-on-corruption feature has no step left to run in; v2 restarts clean on a bad DB instead.

items.title: ctx_page/preview
items.basis: README fixes the 7-tool set; there is no ctx_page. Paging is done through ctx_search offset (PRD).

items.title: ctx_index label scheme
items.basis: Not referenced in PRD or README at all. The owner's issue-intake decision (AI-agent-only template, max debug data) does not set a label scheme for ctx_index; needs its own ADR line.
